# @digitransit-component/digitransit-component-favourite-bar

<!-- Generated by documentation.js. Update this documentation by updating the source code. -->

## formatFavourite

Utility to format location \[name, address] pair.

### Parameters

*   `favourite` **LocationProperties** 

Returns **[Array][1]<[string][2]>** 

## favourites

Required. Array of favourites, favourite object contains following properties.

Type: [Array][1]<[object][3]>

### Properties

*   `address` **[string][2]** 
*   `gtfsId` **[string][2]** 
*   `gid` **[string][2]** 
*   `lat` **[number][4]** 
*   `lon` **[number][4]** 
*   `name` **[string][2]** 
*   `selectedIconId` **[string][2]** 
*   `favouriteId` **[string][2]** 

## onClickFavourite

Required. Function for clicking favourites.

## onAddPlace

Required. Function for selecting "Add place" from suggestions.

## onEdit

Required. Function for selected "Edit" from suggestions.

## onAddHome

Required. Function for "Add home" button.

## onAddWork

Required. Function for "Add work" button.

## lang

Optional. Language, fi, en or sv.

## isLoading

Optional. Whether to show loading animation, true or false.

## colors

Optional color palette

## FavouriteBar

FavouriteBar renders favourites. FavouriteBar displays the first two favourites, the rest are shown in a list.

### Parameters

*   `$0` **[Object][3]** 

    *   `$0.favourites`  
    *   `$0.onClickFavourite`  
    *   `$0.onAddPlace`  
    *   `$0.onEdit`  
    *   `$0.onAddHome`  
    *   `$0.onAddWork`  
    *   `$0.lang`   (optional, default `'fi'`)
    *   `$0.isLoading`   (optional, default `false`)
    *   `$0.colors`   (optional, default `defaultColors`)

### Examples

```javascript
<FavouriteBar
  favourites={favourites}
  onClickFavourite={onClickFavourite}
  onAddPlace={onAddPlace}
  onEdit={onEdit}
  onAddHome={onAddHome}
  onAddWork={onAddWork}
  lang={lang}
  isLoading={isLoading}
/>
```

This module is part of the Digitransit-ui project. It is maintained in the
[HSLdevcom/digitransit-ui](https://github.com/HSLdevcom/digitransit-ui) repository, where you can create
PRs and issues.

### Installation

Install this module individually:

```sh
$ npm install @digitransit-component/digitransit-component-favourite-bar
```

Or install `@digitransit-component/digitransit-component`, which bundles every digitransit-component module:

```sh
$ npm install @digitransit-component/digitransit-component
```
